payload_binding.normalization: UTF-8 exact user-message text as observed by the artificial-cognitive client; repository record stores digest and semantic representation rather than requiring publication of transport metadata
payload_binding.semantic_payload: Everything crossing the input/output interface, regardless of kind, must be suitably persisted in repositories and, at suitable granularity and connectability, advanced as machine-checked new knowledge to Zenodo and where appropriate IETF, in a fully automated manner. The Product Owner states the prior response did not satisfy this acceptance criterion and authorizes implementation.

derivation.reason: This record is a Product-Owner normative requirement and implementation authorization, not a mathematical theorem. Conformance properties of the resulting implementation are machine-checkable separately.

publication.zenodo_rationale: The universal evidence round-trip requirement is architecture-level provenance/publication methodology and is suitable for repository-bound publication after implementation and verification are complete.
publication.ietf_rationale: The requirement has protocol/interoperability relevance if expressed as a portable evidence-envelope and effect-acknowledgement contract.
